career_risk_cards.heading: Safety and responsibility in assistant activity training

risks.mitigation: Follow the therapist's plan and institutional transfer procedures.
risks.scenario: Assisting standing and movement without assessment.
risks.title: Patient transfer falls

risks.affected_roles: Clients, occupational therapy assistants, and supervising therapists
risks.consequence: Changing goals on your own may drift from the established plan and make effects and responsibility hard to review.
risks.mitigation: Record feedback and let the therapist sign off on adjustments.
risks.scenario: Changing the training goals on your own.
risks.title: Goal drift

risks.affected_roles: Clients, caregivers, device instruction staff, and therapists
risks.consequence: Ill-fitting device size, environment, or instruction may cause activity difficulty, pain, or falls.
risks.mitigation: Trial on site and feed back to the therapist.
risks.scenario: Teaching use without verifying size and environment.
risks.title: Ill-fitting assistive devices

risks.affected_roles: Clients, assistants, and the institutional data owner
risks.consequence: Handling identifiable patient materials without approval may disclose health information and damage trust.
risks.mitigation: Use approved systems and minimum-necessary permissions.
risks.scenario: Handling patient materials with unauthorized tools.
risks.title: Medical record privacy

risks.affected_roles: Clients, assistants, therapists, and the team that takes over later
risks.consequence: Not recording pain, fatigue, or progress may delay re-evaluation, adjustment, and risk escalation.
risks.mitigation: Record, hand over, and escalate promptly.
risks.scenario: Not recording pain, fatigue, or effects after training.
risks.title: Missing change records

risks.affected_roles: Clients, assistants, supervising therapists, and institutions
risks.consequence: Unauthorized plan conclusions may cause wrong intervention and unclear responsibility.
risks.mitigation: Review per state law, supervision, and institutional authority.
risks.scenario: Treating a draft as a treatment plan conclusion.
risks.title: Signing beyond authority
